title: Translate
description: Type or paste text and read it in another language.

none.title: No translation engine is available
none.manager: Add a DeepL or Google Cloud key, or set up a model for Polar. Translation in the browser needs desktop Chrome.
none.reader: Ask an administrator to add a DeepL or Google Cloud key, or to set up Polar. Translation in the browser needs desktop Chrome.

history.title: History
history.clearQuestion: Every translation in your history is removed. This cannot be undone.

settings.title: Translate settings
settings.description: Which engines answer here, and the language a translation goes into by default.
settings.browserHint: Free, on the reader's device. Desktop Chrome only.
settings.polarHint: Uses Polar's model and counts toward its limits.
settings.deeplHint: Needs a DeepL key on the Integrations screen.
settings.googleHint: Needs a Google Cloud key on the Integrations screen.

errors.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings.
errors.noEngine: No translation engine can answer. Add a DeepL or Google Cloud key, or set up Polar.
errors.noEngineReader: No translation engine is set up yet. The administrators look after that.
errors.engineUnavailable: That engine cannot answer right now.
errors.limit: You reached Polar's usage limit for now.
errors.paused: That provider is paused after a failure and is tried again shortly.
errors.pausedReader: That engine is paused for now. Try again later.
errors.failed: The translation did not come back. Try again.
errors.rate: Too many translations in a minute. Wait a moment.
errors.tooLong: That text is too long to translate at once.
errors.detectFailed: The language could not be detected.
errors.historyFailed: Your history could not be loaded.
errors.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved.
errors.statusFailed: The engines could not be checked. Translation in the browser still works.
errors.forbidden: Your role does not include Translate.
